releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.4 — Shared Media Selective Delete, 'Go to in Chat', and Message Jump Glow
releaseNotes:
• Selective Delete for Shared Media, Docs & Links: Introduced multi-selection toolbar with 'Select All', badge counter, and batch deletion confirmation dialog inside the Contact Details shared hub.
• 'Go to in Chat' (Jump to Message): Tap 'Show in Chat' on any photo, video, document, or web link to immediately scroll to its location in the chat room with a glowing highlight pulse.
• Quick Actions for Media & Documents: Direct options to View Fullscreen, Open Document, Copy Link, Jump to Chat, or Delete.
• Stealth Foreground Service Notification Info: Clear explanation and control over the background push service notification ('Chess AI Engine • Standing by') keeping real-time calls and messages active without delay.
